applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (western site location verified, two additional transformer locations shown only on electrical plan)
findings.comment: Specific distance from transformer pads to nearest drivable surface/parking area not dimensioned on plans. Site Plan shows one transformer pad within landscaping island immediately adjacent to parking spaces, but exact clearance measurements are not provided. Electrical Plan shows three transformer locations but lacks clearance dimension verification. Cannot confirm compliance with 6-foot minimum distance requirement or verify whether 20-foot all-weather access route is provided.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (western, central, and eastern pads shown on electrical plan)
findings.comment: 20-foot × 35-foot set-up area in front of transformer equipment is not dimensioned or delineated on any plan sheets. No clearance zones or set-up area dimensions are provided for any of the three transformer pad locations. Vertical clearance of 35 feet is not documented. Cannot verify compliance with set-up area requirements.

Specific minimum horizontal width of 12 feet for truck access paths to transformer pads is not documented or dimensioned on any plan. While main drive aisles are shown as 26 feet wide, specific transformer access path widths are not delineated. Cannot verify 12-foot minimum width requirement for transformer access.

Minimum 16-foot vertical clearance for truck access paths to transformer pads is not documented on sections or elevations. Grading Plan shows site topography but does not provide vertical clearance specifications for transformer access routes. Cannot verify compliance with 16-foot minimum vertical clearance requirement.

Access surface materials (hot mix asphaltic concrete vs. Portland cement concrete vs. gravel/unpaved) are not specified or called out on electrical, site, or grading plans. No pavement specifications are shown for transformer access routes. Cannot verify access surfaces are all-weather HMAC or PCC pavement rather than gravel or unpaved.

Structural calculations or pavement design specifications confirming access surface load capacity (72,180 lbs total vehicle weight, 32,530 lbs maximum rear axle weight) are not provided. No structural calculations are referenced or included in available documents. Cannot verify access routes are designed to support required vehicle loads without damage.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations where distance from drivable surface may exceed 6 feet
findings.comment: If transformer pads exceed 6-foot distance from drivable surface, plans do not show laydown curbs with minimum 12-foot width or load capacity specifications. No laydown curb details are provided on any plan sheet. Cannot verify laydown curb requirement or specifications if applicable.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations (central and eastern pads)
findings.comment: Adequate space for truck turnaround at transformer locations is not documented or dimensioned. Site Plan shows drive aisles but does not specifically identify turnaround areas for transformer maintenance vehicles. Cannot verify Austin Energy vehicles can turn around or exit the property after servicing transformers.

24-hour, 7-day-per-week access to transformer pads is not documented. Site Plan shows two gates on property (2-10' Access Gates in north-central area), and no clear notation indicates these do not restrict transformer access or that transformer access is 24/7 gate-free. Cannot verify unrestricted 24/7 access to all transformer locations.

applicableAreas: curbs in front of transformer pads
findings.comment: Storm inlet locations on curbs adjacent to transformer pads are not clearly documented. Drainage Plan was not fully examined for inlet-to-transformer proximity. Cannot definitively verify storm inlets do not block transformer truck access from drainage plan information available.

applicableAreas: gates near transformer pads or vaults
findings.comment: Two 10-foot access gates are shown in north-central area of Site Plan (east of Bldg. 3), far from the labeled transformer pad location on west side. However, plans show only one transformer clearly labeled on Site Plan while Electrical Plan shows three transformer locations. Gate swing directions are not documented, and gates' relationship to the two unlabeled transformer locations on Electrical Plan cannot be evaluated.

applicableAreas: western transformer pad location within landscaping island
findings.comment: Trees are shown immediately adjacent to and within the same landscaping island as the western transformer pad. Site features in close proximity to transformer pad violate requirement that transformer pads be kept clear of structures and landscaping for Austin Energy 24/7 access.

Electrical Plan does not show transformer locations overlaid with drainage plan details. Cannot verify from available site plan documentation whether the three transformer locations shown on Electrical Plan are within stormwater control measures. Detailed overlay of electrical and drainage plans required for verification.

applicableAreas: transformer pad location and fire lanes
findings.comment: Fire Protection Plan does not show explicit fire lane delineations or callouts. The plan shows drive aisles and building layout but does not clearly designate specific fire lanes or their relationship to transformer pad locations. Cannot verify transformer pads do not conflict with fire lanes.
Transformer pad elevation/section details are not provided on Electrical Plan. Cannot verify transformer pads are at grade level rather than placed on raised surfaces from available documentation.

No detailed specifications or justification for pad-mounted transformer method is provided. Site conditions documentation is lacking. Applicant should clarify site-specific conditions that necessitate selected mounting configuration.

Direct line of sight from each transformer pad to its corresponding meter(s) is not documented or verified on plans. Meters appear to be wall-mounted on buildings at various locations while transformers are positioned at different points in parking areas. 2D plan view does not provide sufficient evidence of unobstructed visual path.
Transformer-to-meter distances are not dimensioned or documented on electrical plan. Cannot verify compliance with within-sight requirement or confirm distances do not exceed operational maximum.

Electrical routing from transformers to meters is not traced with documented count of 90-degree turns. Complex branching network of electrical lines is shown but no schematic specifying turn count per conductor run is provided. Cannot verify maximum two 90-degree bends requirement.

Electrical routing crosses over or runs adjacent to storm drain lines at multiple locations on Electrical Plan. Specific clearance distances from electrical conduit to drainage infrastructure are not documented. Cannot verify minimum 12-inch clearance is maintained from drainage pipes and inlets.

Electrical routing origin point appears near western property line. Whether all routing from transformer to meter is 100% on private property rather than in public ROW or easements is not documented. Property boundary overlay with electrical routing is not clearly shown to confirm routing remains within private property.

applicableAreas: transformer pads within 4 feet of parking/traffic areas
findings.comment: If transformer pads are within 4 feet of parking/traffic areas, bollard protection is required. Site Plan shows transformer pad within 2-5 feet of parking/traffic area, potentially triggering requirement. However, no bollards are shown or specified on plans. Cannot verify whether bollards are required or meet specifications.

Minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalks to transformer pads is not dimensioned on plans. Transformer locations relative to sidewalks are shown but specific clearance measurements are not provided. Cannot verify 2-foot minimum clearance is maintained.
No clearance dimensions are shown on electrical plan. Without specific clearance callouts, cannot determine if reduced clearances apply or if AE Design written approval documentation is required.

Meter locations are shown on building walls but specific details regarding whether they are on first floor/ground level and within sight of corresponding transformers are not documented. No written approval documentation is provided for meters in non-standard locations. Cannot verify compliance with meter location requirements.

It is not documented whether meters are behind doors, in meter rooms, or accessible directly from exterior. If meters are behind doors or in enclosed rooms, written approval from AE Design must be documented. No such approval is provided on plans.

applicableAreas: transformer equipment set-up areas and clearances
findings.comment: No set-up area (20 ft × 35 ft with 35-foot vertical clearance) or clearance dimensions are shown on plans. Transformer pads are positioned in landscaping islands and adjacent to parking areas with no delineated set-up areas or clearance zones. Without documented AE Design approval, cannot verify compliance with standard clearance requirements.
